test_title: PYST 33 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: In how much time will a sum of Rs. 14000 amounts to Rs. 20720 at the rate of 6 percent per annum at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 14000

Amount (A) = Rs. 20720

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = A - P

⇒ SI = 20720 - 14000

⇒ SI = 6720

Using SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 6720 = (14000 × 6 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 6720 × 100 = 14000 × 6 × T

⇒ 672000 = 84000 × T

⇒ T = 672000 ÷ 84000

⇒ T = 8 years

**∴ The correct answer is 8 years.**
